title: Pure Call of the Haunted
summary: The ten 2026 Call of the Haunted support cards paired with Call of the Haunted itself, Changshi the Spiridao, Glow-Up Bloom, and generic staples; the page's Eldlich engine is left out. Built around setting and activating multiple copies of Call of the Haunted on the first turn, the deck swarms Level 6 Zombies into Rank 6 and Rank 7 Zombie Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts reveals itself in the hand to Set Call of the Haunted from the hand or Deck (making it activatable that same turn) before sending itself to the GY, and Special Summons a Level 6 Zombie from the Deck when revived by Call of the Haunted.
Stare of the Snake Hair discards itself to search Call of the Haunted or any Spell/Trap that mentions it (Call of the Forgotten, Ectoplasmic Fortification, Vortex of Time, or Deadly Zombie Breath).
Ectoplasmic Fortification searches a Level 6 Zombie or Call of the Forgotten when you control no monsters, or draws cards equal to the number of Call of the Haunted you control.

summary.title: Opening: Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts (1-Card Line)
steps: Reveal Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts in the hand to Set Call of the Haunted from the Deck and send Pumpking to the GY, then immediately activate that Call of the Haunted to revive Pumpking.
Pumpking triggers on Special Summon to bring out Changshi the Spiridao (or Stare of the Snake Hair) from the Deck; Changshi sends Glow-Up Bloom or Army of the Haunted from the Deck to the GY.
Overlay the two Level 6 Zombies into Pumpking the Great Ghost King, which searches Call of the Forgotten to Set up to 3 Call of the Haunted from the Deck/GY, then rank up into The Undying Legion.

summary.title: Call of the Forgotten & Zombie Lock
summary.text: Call of the Forgotten Sets up to 3 copies of Call of the Haunted from your Deck and/or GY on activation, and sends an opposing monster to the GY whenever a Call of the Haunted is activated. Meanwhile, Army of the Haunted Special Summons itself from the hand or GY while you control Call of the Haunted and Sets a Call of the Haunted when sent to the GY. Because Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts and Call of the Forgotten lock your Special Summons to Zombie monsters for the turn, the Extra Deck centers on the archetype's Rank 6 and Rank 7 Zombie Xyz.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Pumpking the Great Ghost King searches a Call of the Haunted card on summon, protects your Zombies, and returns up to 2 cards on the field to the hand.
The Undying Legion ranks up directly on top of a Rank 6 Zombie Xyz and attaches an opposing monster from the field or GY as Xyz Material as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn.

Great Mammoth of the Netherworld destroys a card on the field when summoned alongside Call of the Haunted or another Zombie, and Stare of the Snake Hair locks down an opposing monster's attacks and effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Call of the Haunted revives any monster from your GY in Attack Position and triggers Call of the Forgotten's non-destruction removal every time it flips face-up.

Vortex of Time rewrites an opposing monster effect into a coin-toss banish effect, and Deadly Zombie Breath sends an opposing monster to the GY on the field or trades one of your cards for one of theirs from the GY.

main: Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts
Reveals itself to Set Call of the Haunted, activatable this turn; summoned, brings a Level 6 Zombie from the Deck.
Stare of the Snake Hair
Discards itself to search Call of the Haunted or a Spell/Trap that names it; summoned, shuts down an attacker.
Army of the Haunted
Summons itself from the hand or GY while you control Call of the Haunted; sent to the GY, Sets one.
Great Mammoth of the Netherworld
Summoned next to Call of the Haunted or a Zombie: destroys a card.
Changshi the Spiridao
Generic Level 6 Zombie from the page's line: sends a Zombie from the Deck to the GY.
Glow-Up Bloom
Generic Zombie Tuner: banished from the GY, searches a Level 5 or higher Zombie such as Stare.
Call of the Haunted
The card it's all built on: revives a monster from your GY.
Call of the Forgotten
Field Spell: Sets three Call of the Haunted, and sends an opposing monster to the GY whenever one is activated.
Ectoplasmic Fortification
With no monsters, searches a Level 6 Zombie or Call of the Forgotten; otherwise draws for each Call of the Haunted.
Vortex of Time
Quick-Play: rewrites an opposing effect into a coin toss that banishes.
Deadly Zombie Breath
Sends an opposing monster to the GY; from the GY, trades one of your cards for one of theirs.
extra: Rank 6 Zombie: searches a Call of the Haunted card, shields your Zombies, and bounces two cards.
Rank 7 on top of a Rank 6 Zombie: attaches an opposing monster from the field or GY on their turn.
